content: Petero zu Ioane Kotao Ohoziro
Petero zu Ioaneꞌa ꞌize vaze ḡehaḡa ḡorezeꞌeteꞌea, dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa, kuru neḡa uti vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa zu Sadukea azaḡaniꞌa zeḡe uꞌa ariro.
Zeꞌe apostolo azaḡa aheu mazao maḡune rudaro, mazaḡa apostolo azaḡaniꞌa vaze ihozeꞌenaꞌa, Iesuꞌa bare ḡabodiroteꞌe teige, vaze zuni bare ḡabodiꞌuma rae haraminu.
Eꞌe uꞌano, ze Petero zu Ioane oboze tiro. Ebu mada ꞌai zuburiro ꞌahine, ze ḡuꞌa neḡano ohozadu eꞌea baze irariro.
Rehano zeḡe haramo igiroteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa ḡoereze mae ḡihiniro. Zeḡe boꞌaḡano ohoze niduꞌaꞌe 5,000 heuḡa.
Irarirotene, Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa, vaze boroboro zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Ierusalemao nuꞌoraro.
Dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa Anasi, ebu Kaiafa, Ioane zu Alesana, ebu dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa nabuga duḡuru niduꞌa nuꞌoraro.
Ze Petero zu Ioaneꞌe zeḡe zamao mae ohozadu ḡadiziro, “Za noꞌe gigiꞌaḡa hina ga iniu niḡano odaḡa sauꞌa vazeḡa ꞌahi faineha?”
Ebu Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa Petero iriꞌavonadu Peteroꞌa ziro, “Vazevaze zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu vaze boroboro,
za emeꞌa odaḡa sauꞌa vazeḡa mazao haḡai manoḡa haḡateꞌe zu nougenouge ani fainateꞌe moneo ḡadimuꞌehe?

ꞌOugine, zae niduꞌa zu Isaraela azaḡa niduꞌa ꞌahi ederiꞌuma. Vaze ꞌahiꞌe Nazareta vazeḡa Iesu Keriso niḡano manoradu zae zamao edauꞌohe. Iesuꞌe zaeꞌa satauroniro rehano, Badiꞌaꞌa rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡaboniroteꞌe vazeḡa.
Iesu moneo Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro,

content.text: 'Hadi hina ne ogorarotene, zaeꞌa mae modiroteꞌe hadiḡaꞌe,

content: Eꞌanoꞌo Iesu ane daꞌo emeḡe ḡabofeꞌohe. Haba niduꞌa zamaḡano Badiꞌaꞌa emeḡe ḡabofifine tuḡuniroteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahogaꞌe oꞌoꞌa.”

Nuꞌonuꞌo azaḡaꞌe Petero zu Ioaneꞌa mene rihauꞌenaꞌa, inare ḡoeroga horozirotene zaguzagaro, mazaḡa ze Petero zu Ioaneꞌe edeḡa oꞌoꞌa ebu nize oꞌoꞌa azaḡa rae ederiro. ꞌOugadu ze bare ederiro, vaze aheu ꞌadiꞌe Iesu teite radiunuteꞌe azaḡa.
Rehano ze odaḡa sauꞌa manoriroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa Petero zu Ioane teite edanoga horoniroteꞌe uꞌano, ze ḡoereni ꞌahoga rouga mene idararo.
Eꞌanoꞌo ze Petero zu Ioaneꞌe nu'onu'o habaꞌanonoꞌo mae buzadu zeḡe daꞌo ḡoꞌaneꞌenaꞌa ḡadimutitiro,
“Eme vaze aheu ꞌahi mazao nougiꞌuma? Zeꞌa gigiꞌa haḡaiḡa haḡataꞌaꞌe Ierusalema azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe edeḡa ebu eme zuni eꞌe oꞌonoga mene idaḡa.
Rehano hari ꞌahaꞌa ne azaḡa boꞌaḡano mene bororafine, ꞌahige riḡa ziꞌuma, 'Iesu niḡano vazeni ꞌahoga ago bare ḡorenoꞌi!'”
Ebu hena ze Petero zu Ioane bare huze zouzadu riḡa ziro, “Iesu niḡano ago hune ḡoeroꞌi, zu ago hune ihozoꞌi!”
Rehano Petero zu Ioaneꞌa naenaeziro, “Badiꞌa ubumao noꞌeꞌe duduḡa? Zae ḡoere egoziniꞌuma ga Badiꞌa ḡoere egohaꞌuma? Za zaeꞌa bare ḡadizoꞌi.
Emeꞌe nagini horoniroteꞌe zu igiroteꞌe moneo rae furene huniꞌuma.”

Ebu nuꞌonuꞌo ibitohauꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa bare ḡoere riḡa zeadu tuḡuze buziro. Mazaḡa vaze niduꞌa naginiꞌa fureranateꞌe horonadu Badiꞌa niguniro ꞌahine, apostolo azaḡa adugano tuḡuziteꞌe ibiḡa mene horoniro.
Gigiꞌa haḡaiḡano manoriroteꞌe vazeḡa muriḡaꞌe 40 vitinoga.
Fieꞌeteꞌe Azaḡaniꞌa Kuraro
Petero zu Ioaneꞌe tuḡuze buzirotene, ze fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa vaḡe onamiro ebu dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboroꞌa ziroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa niduꞌa meꞌodoziniro.
Ze ḡoere eꞌe igirotene, zamaze tibano teadu agoze borofeꞌenaꞌa, Badiꞌa mazao kuraro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡaeꞌa adure, raha, davara, zu eꞌe zamaḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌa haḡairo.
Ḡaeꞌa Vine Zaḡoḡa tuḡunadu ḡae tuḡure vazeḡa, vouḡafe Davidaonoꞌo ꞌahige rae reiro,

content.text: zu habaꞌahabaꞌa azaḡaniꞌa huga oꞌoꞌa haḡaiḡa toganeꞌohe?
Raha kiniḡa azaḡaꞌe zeḡeꞌa bare uti ruhibiro,
ebu raha azaḡa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe nuꞌoranadu

content: Aꞌe hube hune fureraro. Heroda zu Pontio Pilatoꞌa Iuda mene azaḡa zu Isaraela azaḡa teite tiburanadu Ierusalemao nuꞌoraro ebu Iesu manoga veize toganiro. Iesuꞌe ḡae tuḡure vazeḡa zaḡoḡa zu ḡaeꞌa ohoniroteꞌe vazeḡa, Keriso.
Zeꞌe ḡaeꞌa ḡae gigiꞌaḡo hina zu urao fureraꞌuma rae irina toganiroteꞌe haḡaiḡa haḡairo.
Zuhiꞌa Boro, izidi zeꞌa riho ḡoeꞌa efateꞌe zamaroꞌi. Eme, ḡae tuḡure azaḡaniꞌa mene hune rihauꞌenaꞌa, ḡae ḡoere rae furenoga veize inarafoꞌi.
Ebu ꞌevoꞌo ꞌeinadu ugi azaḡa faizoꞌi, zu ḡae tuḡure vazeḡa zaḡoḡa Iesu niḡano haḡai nu badeḡa ebu zaguzagatiteꞌe haḡaiḡa haḡaoꞌi.”
Ze kurau hauḡiroteꞌe enogano, zeḡeꞌa nuꞌoraroteꞌe habaꞌaniꞌa hagahagariro. Ebu zeḡe niduꞌa Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa iriꞌavozadu ze mene rihauꞌenaꞌa, Badiꞌa ḡoere inare rae fureniro.
Fieꞌeteꞌe Azaḡaniꞌa Ḡauze Ḡahugotitiro
Fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa zamaze zu zamaroneze tibano teadu vazeni ꞌahoganiꞌa, “ꞌAhiꞌe eḡe daꞌo tohe,” rae mene reiro, rehano “Vaze niduꞌa tohe,” rae raꞌenaꞌa ḡahugotitiro.
Ebu apostolo azaḡaꞌe inaraze boro hina Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesuꞌa bare ḡabodiroteꞌe moneo rae furene onamiro. Ebu Badiꞌaꞌe zeḡe mazao manoḡa borofe fureniro.
Zeḡe boꞌaḡano ḡau ꞌahoganiꞌa fereniroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa. Mazaḡa habazeta azaḡa zu nezeta azaḡaniꞌa eꞌe seronadu hadiḡaꞌe apostolo azaḡa vaḡe odohe ariro,
ebu zeḡe zamao tiro. Ebu apostolo azaḡaniꞌa hadi eꞌe madu hadiꞌa ferezeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ḡahugoziniro.
Vaze ꞌahoga, niḡa Iosefaꞌe Levi urabo vazeḡa zu Kupuro ꞌumuḡa vazeḡa. Aniꞌe apostolo azaḡaniꞌa Banabasi rae huniro (ni eꞌe hugaꞌe 'Inaraziꞌeteꞌe Vazeḡa').
Aniꞌe ane haba seronadu hadiḡa odohe ariro ebu apostolo azaḡa zamao tiro.
